en: A vintage multi-view postcard designed as a strip of photographic film winding across a grey background. Each film frame shows a different landmark or city view in color: a panoramic river-and-mountain view of the city, monumental buildings, a circular colonnade, a war memorial or monument, a fountain in a square with historic buildings, and a church with a tall bell tower. On top of the film strip there are cut-out labels with Italian text.
